# Dibbur

> Free, open-source Hebrew and Arabic dictation for macOS, based on Handy. Speech-to-text runs locally; optional text cleanup can use an external provider.

- Repository: https://github.com/ofershap/dibbur
- Installation: https://dibbur.pages.dev
- Releases: https://github.com/ofershap/dibbur/releases
- Build guide: https://github.com/ofershap/dibbur/blob/main/BUILD.md
- Contribution guide: https://github.com/ofershap/dibbur/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Issues and feature proposals: https://github.com/ofershap/dibbur/issues
- Security: https://github.com/ofershap/dibbur/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Upstream: https://github.com/cjpais/Handy

Published installers target macOS. Windows/Linux ports are contribution proposals, not released Dibbur support. The optional transcript archive is off by default; its MCP server is read-only. Do not infer Apple notarization, platform testing or complete offline operation when an external cleanup provider is enabled.
